QuestInfo.name: The Storybook on the Goblin Story
QuestInfo.0: I'm sure I received the storybook from Chumji after defeating 3 King Goblins. Where did it go? Should I go see Chumji again?
QuestInfo.1: #b#p2040052## from Helios Tower Library has requested me to get #b#t4031238##k for him. Hmmm ... I'm pretty sure I received it after I defeated the King Goblins, but I can't seem to find it. After discussing the matters with Chumji, he promised to give me the storybook if I gather up #b10 #t4000173#s#k for him.\n\n#t4000173# #b#c4000173##k/10
QuestInfo.2: I gave Chumji 10 #t4000173#s just as he requested to reacquire #t4031238#.

0.0: Hey there. Having fun traveling around places? I heard you've been helping out Wiz the Librarian lately. That definitely earns my respect. How can I help you today?
0.1: You lost the storybook that I gave you? Oh no... you should have been more careful with it. Don't worry, though; I have another copy with me. Before I give you this, though, can you do me a favor? It is going to be a piece of cake for you.

yes.0: It has been a tremendous relief for everyone here thanks to you eliminating 3 King Goblins, but the truth is there are still many Goblins roaming around the Black Mountain. Blins, especially, love to pull some nasty pranks on people, which is definitely a concern here. I want you to fight those Goblins and bring #b10 #t4000173#s#k to me. This should be easy for you, right?

no.0: This should not be difficult for you. Don't you need the storybook?

1.0: Did you bring it? Let's see... indeed, 10 brooms. Here's the storybook. Please take good care of it this time.

yes.0: Now that the brooms are here, I think it'll be a good time for the people here and me to sweep up and clean up this town. Lately our town has been frequently visited by the outsiders, and I thought our town could use some cleaning for quite some time. Anyway, so long.

item.0: If you defeat Blins, they'll cough up a #b#t4000173##k. Bring back #b10#k of those.
